explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/19: if G is an edge-disjoint union of n copies of K_n, is χ(G) = n? `EFLConfig` models this as n vertex sets of size n pairwise sharing at most one vertex and covering V, which is exactly edge-disjointness for cliques, and `graph` is the union. The statement quantifies over V : Type and n, with χ taken in ℕ∞. Tagged open because the known proof covers only large n, matching the page. Faithful.
